test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language

A + B means 'A is the wife of B',

A - B means 'A is the brother of B',

A × B means 'A is the sister of B'.

A ÷ B means 'A is the father of B'.

Based on the above, how is P related to N if 'P - B × V ÷ N + E'?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Wife
 Brother
 Sister
 Father
 
 

 

Given: P - B × V ÷ N + E

It means: P is the Brother of B, B is the Sister of V, V is the Father of N, N is the wife of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f6dafd300bf48069a9a80d8b263ba018426d9bb921cad80a43493244bb5a157.png] 

So, P is the **'Father's brother**' of N.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
